prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.)
text:
I write to present a claim on behalf of my client, [CLIENT_NAME], arising from the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The facts are straightforward. Your insured changed lanes without signaling or checking the adjacent lane, and his vehicle sideswiped my client's car, forcing it toward the shoulder. Police responded to the scene, and the report records your insured's admission that he did not see my client's vehicle before moving over.

My client sustained a concussion in the impact. He experienced headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, and his treating physician restricted him from work and driving for an extended period. He has undergone medical evaluation and continues to receive treatment. His medical records and billing statements are enclosed, along with photographs of the damage to his vehicle and a statement from his employer confirming lost wages.

Liability is clear. Your insured breached his duty to drive with reasonable care, and that breach directly caused my client's injuries and losses. Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim in full. This offer remains open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
